_READ_ME: Keys starting with _ are notes and section headings, the plugin ignores them. 'auto' means the value is read from your print. Run 'Unlayered Infill - Check setup' to see what each auto resolved to.
_enabled: true | false -- master switch, false leaves your G-code untouched.
_amplitude: '200%' of layer height, '2x', or mm like '-0.2' -- how far the infill rides up and down in Z.
_frequency: 'auto' or ripples per mm -- auto puts one ripple every 10.5 nozzle widths (1.50 on a 0.4 nozzle).
_pattern: linear | cross -- linear ripples one way, cross is an egg-crate so infill running in ANY direction still rises and falls.
_wave_angle: 'auto' or degrees -- auto runs the ripples square across your profile's infill angle, which is where they do the most work.
_shape: sine | triangle | square -- sine is smooth, triangle has sharper peaks that key harder, square holds full offset longest.
_layer_phase: degrees per waved layer -- 0 stacks every crest in a column, a small value walks them sideways and braids the layers. 180 = crest over trough.
_max_lift_mm: 'auto', 0 for none, or mm -- hard ceiling on the Z offset so a big amplitude cannot drive the nozzle into printed material.
_collision_check: warn | refuse | off -- reports moves whose nozzle would pass under material already printed. refuse stops the export instead.
_nozzle_clearance: 'auto' or mm -- how close the nozzle may pass under printed material before collision_check counts it. auto is a quarter of the layer height.
_require_relative_e: true | false -- refuse absolute-E G-code instead of corrupting it. Leave on, the fix is Printer Settings > Use relative E distances.
_segment_mm: 'auto' or mm -- how finely each infill move is chopped to follow the wave. auto is 2.5 nozzle widths (1.0 mm on a 0.4).
_cell_mm: 'auto' or mm -- resolution of the solid-skin map. auto is one column per nozzle width, the finest the printer can resolve.
_blend_mm: 'auto' or mm -- smooths the fade-out where a ledge makes one column's ceiling much lower than its neighbour's. auto is 5 nozzles.
_full_strength: true | false -- off, the wave peaks at half amplitude mid-span, on, it reaches full amplitude and still fades to nothing at the skins.
_log: true | false -- append a record of every export to the log file named by Check setup.
_restore_backup: true | false -- a one-shot undo. Set true and slice once: every setting this plugin remembers from before is put back, and this returns to false. Check setup prints what is remembered.
